shortDescription: Independent news, culture, commentary, newsletters, and editorials.
fullDescription: Censored Expressions delivers independent news, culture coverage, daily editorials, weekly newsletters, public discussion, and media links in one branded mobile experience.
reviewNotes: The app loads the public Censored Expressions news site. Owner-only tools are protected and are not intended for public reviewer use unless credentials are specifically requested.
requiredChecks: Home page loads from production HTTPS domain.
Creator Desk loads editorials and public comments.
Newsletter page loads current newsletter content.
Legal documents and privacy policy are accessible.
No public navigation exposes private Owner Desk controls.
Images, icons, and backgrounds load correctly from production.
